meta.title: B2B Lead Generation | Pipeline That Closes | CommView
meta.description: B2B lead generation built around ICP, channel fit and sales follow-through. Measure useful pipeline and conversion, not lead volume alone.

h1: More leads is not the answer if the wrong leads arrive.
hero.sub: Lead generation works when targeting, offer, channel and sales follow-through agree on what a useful opportunity looks like. We build around the ICP and measure what happens after the form fill.

diagram.caption: QUALITY BEFORE VOLUME
diagram.sub: The useful number gets smaller as the evidence gets stronger.

sections.heading: The B2B Lead Generation Problem Is Often Quality, Not Volume
intro: A bigger lead number does not fix weak targeting, an unclear offer or a broken route into Sales. It can simply create more work for the same commercial result.
We start by defining the customer and opportunity the business actually wants, then work backwards into channels, offers and capture points.

sections.heading: A B2B Lead Generation Strategy Connected to Sales
sections.intro: The system needs to survive contact with the sales process.

steps.title: ICP
steps.body: Define the accounts and buying situations worth pursuing.

steps.title: Offer
steps.body: Give the right buyer a relevant reason to engage now.

steps.title: Channel
steps.body: Use the places where that audience can realistically be reached or where intent already exists.

steps.title: Capture
steps.body: Remove unnecessary friction from the next step.

steps.title: Route
steps.body: Send useful context to the right commercial owner rather than treating every lead equally.

steps.title: Learn
steps.body: Use downstream conversion and sales feedback to improve the next cycle.

sections.heading: B2B Lead Generation Channels Follow the Buyer
sections.intro: There is no universally best lead generation platform. The useful mix depends on where the [ICP](/ideal-customer-profile-workshop) can be reached and how it buys.

items.title: Search
items.body: Capture existing problem, category and solution intent through SEO and paid search.

items.title: LinkedIn and paid social
items.body: Reach defined professional audiences where the targeting and economics make sense.

items.title: Content
items.body: Create useful reasons for the buyer to engage, return or share information.

items.title: ABM
items.body: Coordinate attention around a defined account universe when the economics justify the focus.

items.title: Intent signals
items.body: Use behavioural evidence as context for prioritisation rather than treating a score as certainty.

items.title: Events and direct engagement
items.body: Create or use moments where a relevant audience is prepared to have a deeper conversation.

sections.heading: Measure What Happens After the Lead

items.title: Fit
items.body: Did the response come from the type of account the business actually wants?

items.title: Progression
items.body: Did the opportunity move into a meaningful commercial stage?

items.title: Pipeline
items.body: What value entered the pipeline and how much of it progressed?

items.title: Learning
items.body: What did Sales and downstream conversion tell us about targeting, offer and channel?

items.a: B2B lead generation is the process of identifying and creating opportunities for potential business customers to engage with a company. Useful lead generation connects the ICP, proposition, channel, offer and sales process. The objective is not simply to collect contact details, but to create commercially relevant opportunities that can progress.

items.q: What's the best B2B lead generation channel?
items.a: There is no single best channel for every B2B company. The answer depends on the ICP, buying behaviour, deal value, existing demand and how easily the audience can be reached. Search can capture intent, LinkedIn can target professional audiences, and content or ABM can create reasons to engage. We choose from the buyer backwards.

items.q: How much does B2B lead generation cost?
items.a: Cost depends on the audience, channel mix, media spend, creative and content requirements, and the level of ongoing execution. Cost per lead alone can be misleading because cheap leads may create little pipeline. Commview scopes investment around the commercial objective and measures the quality of what progresses, not just acquisition volume.

sections.heading: If Sales wants better leads, start before the handoff.
sections.body: We can connect ICP, channel, capture and sales feedback into one lead generation system.
